author: Widogeist
body:
To my knowledge, the only thing that directly influences ornate drop chance for raids is the "Karmic Ornate" buff from Anguish 2.0. But your ornate drop chance goes from ~1/200 to ~1/199 with the buff so it's pretty negligible. Crest of Felling consumable buff and the "Great Felling" in-game event increases the chance of receiving item drops from raids, but it has no influence on quality of drops. Quality (ornate) is RNG.

Edit: On a side note, as your anguish level increases with raids, you can pick certain paths which also passively increases the chance of receiving ornate quality items from raids.
